in-progress-ralph.prompt: Continue the unfinished task from its saved state: keep working or mention an agent for help. When the work is done, run multica-surface-delivery. If the work is truly blocked, run multica-surface-block.

wakeup-for-sub-issue.all_finished_prompt: All child issues are settled. Continue the parent task from its saved result and deliver when ready.
wakeup-for-sub-issue.in_review_prompt: A child submitted work for review. Review its evidence through multica-subissue-review and continue the parent task.
wakeup-for-sub-issue.blocked_prompt: A child is blocked. Inspect its concrete blocker, resolve it or mention an agent for help, and continue the existing assignment.
